name: DEF weekly projection for Sleeper league 1312056164149641216 (NFL Casuals) scoring

coefficients.fit_on: 2024 wk2-18 + 2025 wk1-18 + 2026 wk1-4, every team-game with a closing line

ranking_rule: Sort DEFs by opp_implied_total ascending (lowest first). The ranking needs no fitted numbers; the coefficients only set the points level.

opp_implied_total.meaning: Points the bookmakers expect the DEF's opponent to score this week.
opp_implied_total.source: ESPN scoreboard the tool already loads: https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/football/nfl/scoreboard?seasontype=2&week={w}&dates={season}
opp_implied_total.fields: events[].competitions[0].odds[0].overUnder (game total, O/U) and .spread (HOME team's spread; negative = home favoured). Team abbreviations from competitions[0].competitors[].team.abbreviation with homeAway; map ESPN 'WSH' -> Sleeper 'WAS'.
opp_implied_total.compute: def_spread = spread if DEF team is home else -spread;  opp_implied_total = O/U / 2 + def_spread / 2
opp_implied_total.example: DEF is a 7-point home favourite (def_spread = -7) in a 41.5 total: opp_implied = 20.75 - 3.5 = 17.25 -> 27.75 - 0.819*17.25 = 13.6 pts
opp_implied_total.note: The scoreboard only carries odds before kickoff; past games need the ESPN core odds endpoint (sports.core.api.espn.com/v2/sports/football/leagues/nfl/events/{id}/competitions/{id}/odds). Not needed for live use.

fallback_when_no_odds.source: Sleeper weekly projection row for the DEF (https://api.sleeper.app/projections/nfl/{season}/{week}?season_type=regular&position[]=DEF), stats.pts_allow. It tracks the Vegas implied total at r = 0.98 (mean gap 0.4 pts), so it is nearly the same signal.

optional_tiebreak_not_validated.opp_sacks_allowed_per_game: From Sleeper weekly DEF stats for weeks 1..w-1: sum stats.sack over rows whose `opponent` is this week's opponent, divided by those games. Shrink: (sum + 4 * prior) / (games + 4), prior = 0.5 * opponent's last-season rate + 0.5 * league average (about 2.4).
optional_tiebreak_not_validated.status: Consistent sign in 2024 and 2025-26 (coef SE 0.41) but did not improve out-of-sample ranking (Spearman 0.384 vs 0.386). Use only to split near-ties (implied totals within ~1 point).

deliberately_excluded.team_three_and_out_rate: Coefficient ~0 once the Vegas line is known (e.g. -0.04 +/- 0.60 per 3&O/game, trained 2024+2025 wk1-9). Blending the DEF's own 3&O rate into Sleeper's projection made weekly rankings slightly worse in 2024, 2025 and out-of-sample (Spearman 0.41->0.39, 0.36->0.34, 0.34->0.31 for own-rate weight 0 -> 0.5).
deliberately_excluded.opponent_three_and_outs_allowed: No effect beyond the Vegas line (residual +0.14 vs -0.26 pts for top vs bottom tercile, SE ~0.47).
deliberately_excluded.home_away_spread: Spread and home add nothing once the implied total is in (CV and out-of-sample both flat).
deliberately_excluded.opponent_qb_new_or_rookie: Raw effect is large but Vegas already prices it; residual +1.55 +/- 0.90 (2025-26) vs -0.79 +/- 0.82 for rookies in 2024.

if_keeping_sleeper_projection_instead: Use the league-average stop rate as a flat add-on, not the team's own rate: proj = sum(proj.stats[k] * scoring[k]) + avg_3and_out + avg_4th_stop, with the averages taken over all DEF games so far this season (2025: 2.13 and 0.72 per game; 2026 YTD: 2.15 and 0.59). Week-1 default should be ~2.2 and ~0.65 (engine.js uses 3.0 and 0.5). Also drop pass_int_td from DEF projections: it is scored at -2 (a QB key) and is already inside def_td.

validation.train: coefficients for validation fitted on 2024 wk2-18 + 2025 wk1-9 (intercept 28.91, slope -0.871); the ranking itself is unfitted
validation.paired_vs_tool_today_oos: Spearman +0.07 (SE 0.02); top-1 pick +0.6 pts/wk (SE 1.7); top-3 picks +1.1 pts/wk (SE 1.2) over 13 weeks
